assumptions: Declines are taken to mean all failed card attempts.
The period analysed is 1 to 31 August 2026.
caveats: 8.0% of Meridian Bank's card attempts in August 2026 (2,856 of 35,507) have no issuer ID, where 0% is expected. Issuer-level results are therefore understated. These rows were not corrected and appear as a '(missing)' issuer.
Failure rates are not available for the missing-issuer group, so it cannot be compared with named issuers.

facts.text: There were 17,027 failed card attempts in August 2026. Harbor Bank had the most at 3,489 (20.5% of all declines), followed by Lotus Bank with 3,206 (18.8%) and Ridge Bank with 2,782 (16.3%). The top three issuers account for 55.7% of declines.
Indigo Bank had 2,598 failed attempts (15.3%), Coral Bank 2,558 (15.0%) and Banyan Bank 2,004 (11.8%).
390 failed attempts (2.3%) have no issuer name attached, so they cannot be assigned to any issuer.

Failure rates (failures as a share of each issuer's own attempts) are fairly close across issuers: Harbor Bank 13.1%, Lotus Bank 13.0%, Ridge Bank 13.5%, Indigo Bank 13.5%, Banyan Bank 13.5% and Coral Bank 14.2%.

response.headline: Three issuers drove over half of August's 17,027 failed card attempts: Harbor Bank (20.5%), Lotus Bank (18.8%) and Ridge Bank (16.3%), together 55.7%.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Compare each issuer's failure rate with the overall card failure rate and with prior months to see whether any issuer's rate moved unusually.
hypotheses.rationale: Failure rates sit in a narrow 13.0% to 14.2% band, while attempt volumes range from 14,880 to 26,638. The highest-volume issuers (Harbor Bank, Lotus Bank) top the decline count despite having some of the lowest failure rates.
hypotheses.text: The ranking of issuers by decline count is mostly explained by how many card attempts each issuer handles, not by one issuer being unusually weak.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Check Coral Bank's failure rate trend over recent months and break its declines down by failure code.
hypotheses.rationale: Its rate is about one point above the other issuers, but the gap is small and no prior-period comparison is in the evidence.
hypotheses.text: Coral Bank may deserve attention on rate rather than count, since it has the highest failure rate (14.2%) despite ranking fifth by number of declines.

recommendations.rationale: These three issuers hold 55.7% of declines, so fixes here have the largest absolute impact.
recommendations.text: Break down Harbor Bank, Lotus Bank and Ridge Bank declines by failure code to see which reasons dominate.

recommendations.rationale: Missing issuer IDs mean issuer-level counts are understated and 390 declines are unattributed.
recommendations.text: Fix the missing issuer ID capture, starting with Meridian Bank card attempts, and rerun this analysis afterwards.

recommendations.rationale: It has the highest failure rate of the named issuers.
recommendations.text: Review Coral Bank's failure rate against its own history.
